title: The Ruins of Thornwall Keep
intro: You stand at the edge of a mossy clearing. The crumbling towers of Thornwall Keep loom before you, silent against a grey sky. Rumors say the old keep hides a treasure — and something else. Something old. You adjust your pack and push forward.
author: A. Designer

win_condition.message: The wraith is destroyed. A deep silence settles over the undercroft. Whatever evil held Thornwall Keep is gone. You have completed The Ruins of Thornwall Keep!
